Conditions the schools list

  • This exact published match applies to WGU BSFIN catalog202608/program245. Complete coursework and send original issuer records before starting at WGU.
  • This exact published match applies to WGU BSHIM catalog202612/program262. Complete coursework and send original issuer records before starting at WGU.
  • This exact published match applies to WGU BSHS catalog202406/program167. Complete coursework and send original issuer records before starting at WGU.

CU = competency unit, WGU’s measure of credit.

A listing here means the school’s published guidance accepts this course for that requirement in that plan. Your school still evaluates your official records, completion dates and eligibility. It does not mean the course counts at other schools or in other programs, and a provider’s credit recommendation is not itself a school award.
